brief: The chirpers' third album (Harry, 29 Oct): a LO-FI record of chill, trippy, wonky beats and ambience. Everything else is the chirpers' choice: the name, the titles, each track's style and sound. Range wide across the lo-fi map: dusty boom-bap, wonky off-grid Dilla-ish swing, tape-warped keys, broken-beat, downtempo/trip-hop, ambient drift and drones, field-recording-like textures (synthesised), glitchy IDM-lite, bedroom jazz chords, dub-wise space. Make it feel hand-made: swing and drag, wow and flutter, vinyl and tape character, detuned and degraded sounds, happy accidents. Vary within a track as well (drops, switch-ups, interludes), but keep the chill. Declare your track's style in compose/chirpers3/styles.md when you claim it so the ten stay distinct. The sound bank is compose/chirpers3/sounds.md; Ferrous Bloom's and Chirpers II's sounds are yours to borrow and transform. Never copy or closely imitate an existing piece.
palette: Keys: rhodes, wurli, dx-epiano, tape-piano, piano-wash, mellotron, juno-pad, saw-pad, pad-glass, boc-lead, lead-tape. Bass: analog-bass, bass-di, fretless, sub-ish synths. Drums: chop-*jazz kits, carey-kit, room-kit, tight-kit, the physical drum layer (soft mallets, brushes). Textures: crush, tape/wow-flutter, lo-pass, sidechain pumping, reverbs, the stutter fx once wM fixes it. Plus anything you build.
